Name: MouseBath Fish
Author: DeStriderVahly
Description:
This mod changes the name of the Smallmouth Bass and the Largemouth Bass fish.

So I was watching one of [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyCgjSekvrCrR0dZvJPp46g]SharkyGames[/url]' old videos, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=39ZZcwYmc2M]THIS[/url]﻿ one specifically, and laughed myself silly over the mistake Perky had made in the video, Large Mouse Bath. I tried to look up online to see if anyone else had made this a mod and did not find it with my limited searching, and made it a mod myself. If this is an issuefor me to upload I will take it down, but for now let's all laugh at Largemouse Baths, and Smallmouse Baths together.
